![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7d79748aee46485cbd567dc55131ab52~mv2.png)

This written guide was made with the support of Bethesda Softworks, a ZeniMax Media Company. Game™ content and references in this guide are based on the PC version of the game.

__Fishing Bait__

You can’t fish without bait, and the type you use makes a big difference in spawn rates. There are three kinds of bait, and each one increases your chances of catching rare or region-specific fish. If you're hoping to reel in a Glowing fish or a Local Legend, choosing the right bait is just as important as the weather conditions.

**Common Bait**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_25ba285c02ad45b1b3a4a84c0b511e15~mv2.jpg)

**Description**

Basic worms used for fishing.

**How to Obtain**

- **Daily Pip-Boy Quest: Big Fish in a Small Pond:** 
 - Rewards 10 Common Bait
- **Live Bait Barrel (C.A.M.P. Resource)** :
 - Chance to generate Common Bait
- **Coolers & Broken Fridges:** - Chance for 1 to 2 Common Bait. Can Do! perk card does not improve the chances
- **Casting Off Quest:** - Rewards 10 Common Bait
- **Purchase from The Fisherman & Captain Raymond Clark:** 
 - You can server hop to reset the vendor’s inventory, but they sell 100 at a time, so you probably won’t need to do this often.

**Improved Bait**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_69234aefac964788914a0b6b006b9934~mv2.jpg)

**Description**

Improve your chances of hooking the big one with 'Improved Bait.

Greater chance of catching rarer fish than Bait.

**How to Obtain**

- **Daily Pip-Boy Quest: Big Fish in a Small Pond:** 
 - Rewards 5 Improved Bait
- **__Live Bait Barrel__** **(C.A.M.P. Resource)** :
 - Chance to generate Improved Bait
- **Coolers & Broken Fridges:** - Chance for 1 to 2 Improved Bait. Can Do! perk card does not improve the chances
- **Casting Off Quest:** - Rewards 5 Improved Bait
- **Public Events:** - 100% chance to reward Improved Bait. You'll always get 1, 2, or 3 pieces.

**Superb Bait**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9749e9c8679a48da85d7237512029b6c~mv2.jpg)

**Description**

Get the top-of-the-line bait for your never-ending line-casting escapades!

Greater chance of catching rarer fish than Improved Bait

**How to Obtain**

- **Season Scoreboard (Main Pages):** 
 - Redeem 5 pieces for 15 and 20 Tickets.
- **Bonus Page Two (Repeatable):** 
 - Redeem 5 pieces for 75 Tickets. Can be claimed repeatedly during the season.

**Conditions**

You don’t need to upgrade your fishing rod to use Superb Bait — it works with the base rod. But without rod mods, it’s very hard to catch rare fish. Rod mods strengthen your line, speed up reeling, and prevent fish from escaping.

__Weather Conditions__ 

Just like bait, there are three types of weather conditions that affect the catch and spawn rates of fish and axolotls:

**Rainy Weather**

Increases your chances of catching Uncommon Region Fish, Common Region Fish, and Axolotls.

**Nuclear Weather**

Offers the highest chance to catch Glowing Fish, and also improves spawn rates for Uncommon Region Fish, Axolotls, and Local Legends when using Superb Bait.

**No Weather** 

(includes clear skies or any weather that isn’t rainy or within a nuke zone)

Best for catching Generic Fish with Common Bait, and offers moderate chances for Common Region and Uncommon Region Fish when using Improved or Superb Bait.

__Rainy Weather Conditions__

Counts as Rainy Weather when any of the following are happening:

- It’s misty and rainy
- It’s raining
- It’s heavy rain with low visibility
- A Thunderstorm Weather Station is active within the area you’re fishing
- A Snow Weather Station is active within the area you’re fishing
- A Snow Aurora Weather Station is active within the area you’re fishing

__Nuke Weather Conditions__

Counts as Nuke Weather when any of the following are happening:

- There’s a radiation storm
- There’s a Nuke Zone
- A Mothman Weather Station is active within the area you're fishing
- A Radstorm Weather Station is active within the area you’re fishing
- A Nuke Zone Weather Station is active within the area you’re fishing
- A Skyline Valley Weather Station is active within the area you’re fishing

Your CAMP’s active weather machine takes priority and overrides all other weather conditions, including Nuke Zones and Natural Weather — only one weather effect applies to the spawn rates at a time. You’ll also receive the full benefit from someone else’s CAMP weather if you’re fishing there, even if you don’t own the weather machine yourself.

__Spawn Rates__

When you cast your line, the game runs through a fixed list to decide what you catch. It checks for the rarest fish first—Local Legends, but only if you're at the right location. Then it tries for Glowing Fish, followed by Axolotls (if one is active that month in the region you are fishing in).

If those don’t succeed, it continues down the list—Uncommon, Common, and finally Generic fish. If every check fails, you’ll get junk instead. This fallback system guarantees that every cast gives you *something*, even if it’s not the fish you were hoping for.
